segments.name: Antibody-based therapeutics
segments.description: Clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company discovering, developing, manufacturing and commercializing innovative antibody-based therapeutics, including antibody-drug conjugates and multi-specific antibodies, for the…
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating and reportable segment, which is discovering, developing, manufacturing and commercializing innovative antibody-based therapeutics for the treatment of cancer.

revenueModel.text: Collaborators and partners pay upfront payments, option and milestone fees and royalties, while the company also earns product sales and contract manufacturing fees.
revenueModel.evidence: Total revenue includes collaborative and other agreements, product sales, net, contract manufacturing, and government agreements.

changes.text: In 2025 the company recast prior period segment information, moving discontinued projects previously presented separately in 2024 and 2023 into Other programs.
changes.evidence: These changes include moving discontinued projects separately presented in 2024 and 2023 into Other programs and presenting programs separately in 2025 for molecules no longer in a preclinical phase.
